name: GetAccountSummary
label: Get Salesforce Account Summary
description: Retrieves summary information about an Account, such as count of related contacts, opportunities, etc.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.label: Account ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Account to summarize (required).

fields.name: SummaryData
fields.label: Summary Data
fields.description: The summary data as a JSON string (e.g., contact count, opportunity count).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce.
